rationale: Trace stays connected at all samples; each point has voltage_pu at or above the piecewise ride-through minimum for elapsed time since t=0 (0.55>=0.2 at t<=0.15, >=0.5 at t<=0.7, >=0.85 at t<=2.0). Reactive support: after first_below_0.9 (0.05s)+0.1s deadline, samples with V<0.9 require iq>=0.2; at t=0.12 iq=0.25; later samples at or above 0.9 pu do not require support.
